roleLabel: Shield-powered Warrior carry — convert Shields into AoE finish damage
bestFor: Boards that can feed Kai Shields (Warrior / Shield relics) and want a mid-front bruiser who also clears packs
strength: Resolute Strike turns leftover Shields into bonus damage, so defense and offense come from the same resource
weakness: Without Shield sources he is just a slow melee; dies to focus if you place him as a pure tank without sustain

howToPlay.early: He can open as your front-mid if you immediately buy Shield or Defense pieces. Do not leave him naked on the engage tile for three fights.
howToPlay.mid: Decide the Rank B path: Unstoppable (more Shields → more Attack), Bold (faster / wider strike + Defense Shields), or Intrepid (Rush Crit / Warrior shred). Itemize to that path.
howToPlay.late: Stack Shield generation and keep casting Resolute Strike every fight. Bloodshield / Aegis-style Warrior relics are higher priority than random Attack.
howToPlay.positioning: Front-mid, not isolated wing. He wants enemies around him when the delayed strike lands.

abilityNotes.Resolute Strike: The delay is the skill: you win if he still has Shields when the hit lands. Protect him for those ~2.5 seconds or the bonus damage evaporates.

specNotes.The Unstoppable: Default carry path when Shield relics are flowing — every Shield gain also pumps Attack.
specNotes.The Bold: Take when you want faster casts and a bigger smash, and you can stack Defense for lasting Shields on cast.
specNotes.The Intrepid: Take with Rush / Crit Warrior boards. Backup-friendly shred path — better in multi-Warrior comps than solo Kai.

relicReasons.warriors-bloodshield-engine-4000: Directly feeds the Shield → damage identity Resolute Strike is built around.
relicReasons.warriors-aegis-banner-513: Warrior Shield banner — keeps Kai alive through the charge window.
relicReasons.warriors-sundering-filigree-3001: Helps Warrior packs crack tanks so his AoE finish actually cleans up.

faq.question: Is Kai good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Strong when Shield economy is real. Weak as a naked early pickup with no Defense/Shield plan. If the shop gives Aegis/Bloodshield pieces, he spikes hard.

faq.question: What class is Kai?
faq.answer: Warrior. Role focus: shield-powered melee who converts remaining Shields into AoE damage.

faq.question: What relics work with Kai?
faq.answer: Warrior Shield / Bloodshield engines, Aegis banners, and martial amplifiers. Prioritize Shield generation over pure Crit unless you took Intrepid.

faq.question: How do you play Kai?
faq.answer: Stack Shields, stand him where packs clump, cast Resolute Strike, and pick Unstoppable if you want the simplest scaling loop.

tips: Watch the cast: if he burns Shields before the strike, fix positioning or buy more Shield gen — do not just buy Attack.
Intrepid wants friends. Solo Kai usually prefers Unstoppable or Bold.
